scope: Interactive database repair following user request; restart attempt 1 of 3

resource_observations.source: Supabase Safari dashboard, prior to restart

diagnostic_snapshot.note: Observed immediately before the restart completed. No long active client query was present in this snapshot.

queries.query: select public.dispatch_fuel_national()

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_job_id", "p_stations" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_job_id" bigint, "p_stations" jsonb) LIMIT $4) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "public"."publish_fuel_station_batch"("p_job_id" := pgrst_body."p_job_id", "p_stations" := pgrst_body."p_stations") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT $5::bigint AS total_result_set, $6 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->$7, $8) AS body, nullif(current_setting($9, $10), $11) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($12, $13), $14) AS response_status, $15 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "publish_fuel_station_batch".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "publish_fuel_station_batch"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t
select public.dispatch_fuel_discovery()
insert into cron.job_run_details (jobid, runid, database, username, command, status) values ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_ids" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_ids" text[]) LIMIT $4) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "public"."fuel_station_metadata_needed"("p_ids" := pgrst_body."p_ids") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT $5::bigint AS total_result_set, $6 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->$7, $8) AS body, nullif(current_setting($9, $10), $11) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($12, $13), $14) AS response_status, $15 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "fuel_station_metadata_needed".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "fuel_station_metadata_needed"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t
select public.publish_completed_national_trends()

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT "pgrst_call".* FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_region" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_region" text) LIMIT $4) pgrst_body , LATERAL "public"."claim_fuel_national_region_job"("p_region" := pgrst_body."p_region") pgrst_call) SELECT $5::bigint AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $6) AS body, nullif(current_setting($7, $8), $9) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($10, $11), $12) AS response_status, $13 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "record".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "record"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t
select public.dispatch_fuel_projection_repair()
update cron.job_run_details set status = $1, return_message = $2, start_time = $3, end_time = $4 where runid = $5
update cron.job_run_details set status = $1 where runid = $2

WITH    rows AS (      SELECT ctid      FROM net._http_response      WHERE created < now() - $1      ORDER BY created      LIMIT $2    )    DELETE FROM net._http_response r    USING rows WHERE r.ctid = rows.ctid

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_lat", "p_lon" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_lat" double precision, "p_lon" double precision) LIMIT $4) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "public"."driving_research_stations"("p_lat" := pgrst_body."p_lat", "p_lon" := pgrst_body."p_lon") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT $5::bigint AS total_result_set, $6 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->$7, $8) AS body, nullif(current_setting($9, $10), $11) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($12, $13), $14) AS response_status, $15 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "driving_research_stations".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "driving_research_stations"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t
update cron.job_run_details set job_pid = $1, status = $2 where runid = $3
select public.watchdog_fuel_national()

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_id", "p_hash" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_id" uuid, "p_hash" text) LIMIT $4) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "public"."access_driving_research"("p_id" := pgrst_body."p_id", "p_hash" := pgrst_body."p_hash") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT $5::bigint AS total_result_set, $6 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->$7, $8) AS body, nullif(current_setting($9, $10), $11) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($12, $13), $14) AS response_status, $15 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "access_driving_research".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "access_driving_research"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t
SELECT case when pg_is_in_recovery() then $2 else (pg_walfile_name_offset(lsn)).file_name end, lsn::text, pg_is_in_recovery() FROM pg_backup_start($1, $3) lsn

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT pgrst_call.pgrst_scalar FROM (SELECT $1 AS json_data) pgrst_payload, LATERAL (SELECT "p_id", "p_hash", "p_events" FROM json_to_record(pgrst_payload.json_data) AS _("p_id" uuid, "p_hash" text, "p_events" jsonb) LIMIT $4) pgrst_body , LATERAL (SELECT "public"."ingest_driving_research"("p_id" := pgrst_body."p_id", "p_hash" := pgrst_body."p_hash", "p_events" := pgrst_body."p_events") pgrst_scalar) pgrst_call) SELECT $5::bigint AS total_result_set, $6 AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t.pgrst_scalar)->$7, $8) AS body, nullif(current_setting($9, $10), $11) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($12, $13), $14) AS response_status, $15 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "ingest_driving_research".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "ingest_driving_research"   LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) _postgrest_t
select public.dispatch_fuel_national_retention()

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT "pgrst_call".* FROM "public"."claim_fuel_repair"() pgrst_call) SELECT $3::bigint AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $4) AS body, nullif(current_setting($5, $6), $7) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($8, $9), $10) AS response_status, $11 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "fuel_repair_jobs".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "fuel_repair_jobs"   LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2) _postgrest_t
update cron.job_run_details set status = $1, return_message = $2, end_time = $3 where runid = $4

select jsonb_build_object(
 $1,(select to_jsonb(c) from public.fuel_national_config c),
 $2,(with slots as (
   select s, s+interval $3 deadline from fuel_national_config c
   cross join lateral generate_series(c.operational_starts_at,date_trunc($4,now()),interval $5) s
   where c.continuous and c.operational_starts_at is not null and s>=now()-interval $6
  ) select jsonb_build_object($7,count(*),$8,count(*) filter(where r.status=$9),
   $10,count(*) filter(where r.status=$11),
   $12,count(*) filter(where r.id is null and deadline<=now()),
   $13,count(*) filter(where r.id is null and deadline>now()),
   $14,count(*) filter(where r.status=$15 and deadline<=now()))
   from slots left join fuel_national_runs r on r.slot_at=s),
 $16,(select jsonb_build_object($17,count(*)) from fuel_national_retention_candidates()),
 $18,(select jsonb_build_object($19,count(*),$20,min(run_id),$21,min(published_at),
   $22,extract($23 from now()-min(published_at))/$24,
   $25,min(run_id) is distinct from (select id from fuel_national_runs where status=$26 order by slot_at desc limit $27)) from public.fuel_national_trends_cache),
 $28,(select jsonb_build_object($29,r.id,$30,r.slot_at,$31,r.completed_at,
   $32,(select count(*) from fuel_national_jobs j left join fuel_national_trend_batches b on b.job_id=j.id and b.source_sha256=j.sha256 where j.run_id=r.id and j.status=$33 and b.job_id is null))
   from fuel_national_runs r where status=$34 order by slot_at desc limit $35),
 $36,(select jsonb_agg(p) from (select job_id,attempts,last_error,lease_until,next_attempt_at,completed_at from fuel_projection_repairs order by job_id desc limit $37)p),
 $38,public.fuel_national_archive_bytes(),
 $39,pg_database_size(current_database()),
 $40,(select coalesce(sum((metadata->>$41)::bigint),$42) from storage.objects),
 $43,(select jsonb_agg(r) from public.fuel_national_regions r),
 $44,(select jsonb_agg(h) from (select * from public.fuel_national_regional_health order by slot_at desc limit $45) h),

WITH    rows AS (      SELECT id      FROM net.http_request_queue      ORDER BY id      LIMIT $1    )    DELETE FROM net.http_request_queue q    USING rows WHERE q.id = rows.id    RETURNING q.id, q.method, q.url, timeout_milliseconds, array(select key || $2 || value from jsonb_each_text(q.headers)), q.body

select jsonb_build_object($1,now(),$2,(select to_jsonb(c)from fuel_national_config c),$3,(with slots as(select s from generate_series($4::timestamptz,date_trunc($5,now()),interval $6)s where s>=now()-interval $7)select jsonb_build_object($8,count(*),$9,count(*)filter(where r.status=$10),$11,count(*)filter(where r.status=$12),$13,count(*)filter(where r.id is null and s+interval $14<=now()),$15,count(*)filter(where r.status=$16and s+interval $17<=now()))from slots left join fuel_national_runs r on r.slot_at=s),$18,(select jsonb_agg(x)from(select * from fuel_national_health order by slot_at desc limit $19)x),$20,(select jsonb_agg(r)from fuel_national_regions r),$21,(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object($22,jobname,$23,active))from cron.job where jobname like $24),$25,(select jsonb_build_object($26,min(run_id),$27,min(published_at),$28,count(*))from fuel_national_trends_cache),$29,(select count(*)from fuel_national_jobs j left join fuel_national_trend_batches b on b.job_id=j.id and b.source_sha256=j.sha256 where j.run_id=(select id from fuel_national_runs where status=$30order by slot_at desc limit $31)and j.status=$32and b.job_id is null),$33,(select jsonb_build_object($34,sum(j.attempts),$35,sum(j.attempts*cardinality(b.station_ids)))from fuel_national_jobs j join fuel_national_batches b on b.catalog_id=j.catalog_id and b.ordinal=j.ordinal where j.run_id=(select id from fuel_national_runs order by slot_at desc limit $36)))status

WITH pgrst_source AS (SELECT "pgrst_call".* FROM "public"."fuel_national_retention_candidates"() pgrst_call) SELECT $3::bigint AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $4) AS body, nullif(current_setting($5, $6), $7) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($8, $9), $10) AS response_status, $11 AS response_inserted FROM (SELECT "record".* FROM "pgrst_source" AS "record"   LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2) _postgrest_t

select set_config([literal], $1, true), set_config([literal], $2, true), set_config([literal], $3, true), set_config([literal], $4, true), set_config([literal], $5, true), set_config([literal], $6, true), set_config([literal], $7, true)
